violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: WHITE SAUCE AT 66F ABOVE PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control (TPHC) as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC WILL USE TPHC PROCEDURES AND DISCARD UNUSED OR UNSOLD PORTIONS AT 4:45PM. EHS WILL FORWARD TPHC DOCUMENTATION TO PIC.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee(s) was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: OBSERVED EMPLOYEE HANDLING BREAD WITHOUT GLOVES.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO WASH HANDS AND APPLY GLOVES BEFORE HANDLING READY TO EAT FOODS. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: WORKING SQUEEZE BOTTLES OF SAUCES, CONDIMENTS WITHOUT LABELS OVER PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC LABELED BOTTLES DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cooking Raw Animal Foods, Minimum of 155F
violations.observation: The following comminuted or ground meat, fish, or game animal was not cooked to a sufficient temperature and/or time to eliminate pathogenic bacteria: OBSERVED BEEF PATTY COOKED TO 135F.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods such as ratites, injected meats, comminuted meats, commercially raised game animals, and raw eggs not for immediate consumption shall be cooked to a minimum internal temperature of 155F for at least 15 seconds. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO HAVE PATTIES COOKED TO MINIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 155F. PIC RETURNED PATTY TO GRILL TOP TO CONTINUE COOKING.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): OBSERVED SHREDDED LETTUCE AND SLICED CHEESE IN NON FUNCTIONING 3 DOOR PREP TOP USING TIME AS PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL PROCEDURE WITHOUT TIME LABELS.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO PLACE TIME LABLES DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. OBSERVED ONIONS STORED ON SHELVING WITH CLEANING CHEMICALS AND CLEANING CHEMICALS STORED STORED ON SHELVING WITH CLEAN UTENSILS.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC RELOCATED ONIONS AND REMOVE CLEANING CHEMICALS FROM SHELVING WITH CLEAN UTENSILS DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERVED IN USE/WORKING BOTTLES OF OIL, SPICES AND SAUCES WITHOUT LABELS OVER PREP TOP AND GRILL LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO APPLY LABLES DURING INSPECTION.
